key_patterns: src/http.js createHttpClient({ fetchImpl, githubToken, sleep, nowMs, userAgent }).fetchText(url, { timeoutMs=20000, maxBytes=8_000_000, accept, deadlineAt }) -> { status, text, finalUrl, contentType }; headersFor(url, accept) builds request headers per hop (BROWSER_USER_AGENT except IDENTIFIED_HOSTS; api.github.com gets the Bearer token), so a cross-host redirect drops host-scoped headers; once() follows redirects manually, builds `detail` from the fixed response-header allowlist DETAIL_HEADERS + a 300-char tag-stripped body snippet and throws HttpError(status, url, retryAfter, detail); retryable(err, host) is host-aware (reddit never, www.googleapis.com never, youtube 404 yes) and retryPlan(host) is [2000] except youtube; a retry is skipped when deadlineAt - nowMs() < 25_000; redactKey() rewrites key= inside googleapis URLs and runs in HttpError/TimeoutError/BodyTooLarge/formatDetail; errorClass(err) -> 'HTTP 403' | 'timeout' | 'network' | 'body too large' | 'parse error: <kind>'; errorSummary(err, { onRunner }) -> 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare' for Cloudflare 403s. src/pipeline.js runSource(source, deps = { http, now, nowMs, logger, onRunner, youtubeApiKey, previous* }) builds fetchText with the source's accept and a 45 s deadline, races work against the backstop, records { status, items, fetched, kept, ms, httpStatus, note, error, detail } and appends notes with '; ' (apiNote precedent: `api: <class>, fell back to feed`); run() reads env (GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_ACTIONS, YOUTUBE_API_KEY) once and passes values down; meta.sources[id] = { id, ...rest } so note flows through. src/parsers/sitemap.js fetches article pages via ctx.fetchText(loc, { timeoutMs: 8000, maxBytes: 1_500_000, accept: ACCEPT.html, deadlineAt }). src/schema.js validateSource error strings read `sources[i].field must ...` (fail(p, what)). sources.config.mjs is the single declarative registry; buildRegistry spreads every field so new keys are harmless. scripts/probe-sources.mjs mirrors run()'s deps for one-off probes.
